## AL-455 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (C.2): INP now headless-gated — the last un-gated Core Web Vital on the CORE PRODUCT closed
- **Verify-before-implement:** git clean (last commits mine — AL-454/453); prod home 200. Read § C/§ D — all boxes `[x]`, but C.2 explicitly documented "**INP not headless-gated**" — the ONE named Core-Web-Vital target (INP≤200ms) with NO probe on deployed sites. `verify-cwv.mjs` measures LCP+CLS on a passive cold load but skips INP ("interaction-driven, cannot be produced by a headless page load with no user input"). Highest-value UNCHECKED dimension.
- **Root insight (why it WAS skippable, now isn't):** Playwright clicks are TRUSTED CDP input → they register as real `event`-timing entries with an `interactionId`, identical to a human tap. So a headless probe CAN produce INP by DRIVING real interactions + reading the Event Timing API (the exact quantity field-INP is computed from: input-delay + processing + presentation-delay of the worst interaction).
- **Shipped `e2e/site-quality/verify-inp.mjs`** (auto-globs into site-quality `run-all.mjs`): installs a `PerformanceObserver({type:'event', durationThreshold:0, buffered:true})` BEFORE interacting, drives a sequence of always-present NON-navigating template controls (`button[aria-label="Open command palette"]` / `[aria-label^="Theme:"]` / `[aria-label="Open menu"]`+`"Close menu"` / FAQ `button[aria-expanded]`) with 220ms settle between, then gates the max `duration` among `interactionId>0` entries ≤200ms. Absent controls skipped; <2 measurable interactions → NOT-MEASURABLE fail-open (validator-precision, never a false-pass).
- **PROD-GREEN @390px (mobile, INP worst-case):** parnassus-books **48ms** · ironhaus-houston **32ms** · gentle-dental-seattle **40ms** — each over 3 real state-changing interactions (menu open/close + FAQ accordion). All well under 200ms AND the 100ms cinematic aim — generated sites are snappy. Non-vacuous: the driven interactions re-render nav + expand panels (real work); a heavy-hydration/janky-handler regression on a future build now flips RED.
- **Files mine only:** `e2e/site-quality/verify-inp.mjs` (new) + `_APP_COMPLETION.md` (C.2 INP-gated) + `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`. No FE/worker/template change (probe-only — INP is already green on the current template; this is the durable measurement that was missing). § C.2 now gates ALL of LCP+CLS+INP; the last un-gated CWV is closed.

## AL-471 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY §C.1: finalizeSeoInvariants now EXPANDS <50 titles (append ` | {city}`) — closes a live title-length gap on the freshest build

Flips green on rebuild (C.1 precedent — the finalizer runs at build finalize; NO redeploy of existing sites).

Also C.2 LCP borderline (2096ms) — a separate CWV slice (hero-image weight/priority).

## AL-472 — ADMIN INTEGRITY (facet-2 truthful data): activation funnel Delivered under-counted 106 vs 155 — root-caused + fixed (counts site.generated)
- **Verify-before-implement:** git clean (last mine — AL-471); prod 200. Facet-1 admin-surf @1280 CLEAN (23 sections); facet-2 reconcile-surfaces 0 divergences (14 surfaces). Ran the full admin-verify run-all → all green EXCEPT **`funnel-reconcile` 🔴 CHECK**.
- **The finding (facet-2):** super-admin Activation Funnel "Delivered" display = **106** (365d; 30d=105, **7d=0**) vs D1 store **155 published** (floor 124) — 7d=0 despite ~20 deliveries THIS week (Catbird, Troegs…). A real display<store under-count.
- **Root cause (Tinybird MCP ground truth):** `site.published` events FROZE at **2026-09-06** (last7d=0) while `site.generated` keeps flowing (Catbird build 09-13 08:50). The dominant create-from-search build path (Cloudflare Workflows, `site-generation.ts:1984`) emits **`site.generated`** on delivery — NOT `site.published` (only the bolt-editor + claim-callback paths emit that). The funnel's Delivered stage (`activation_funnel.ts` + the Tinybird pipe `WHERE event IN`) counts ONLY `site.published` → every workflow delivery is invisible to it.
- **Root fix (proven on LIVE data via MCP, 106→151, 7d 0→45):** the pipe canonicalizes `site.generated` → the `site.published` Delivered stage (`WHERE` adds it + `multiIf` ordinal 2 + stage-merge, so both delivery events count once per DISTINCT site). SSOT (`activation_funnel.ts`) adds `DELIVERED_EVENTS` + `ACTIVATION_INGEST_EVENTS` + `funnelStage('site.generated')→Delivered`; worker query layer UNCHANGED (keys the merged count). Chose this over emitting `site.published` from the workflow — that would DOUBLE-FIRE Hatchet post-publish orchestration (both are HATCHET_EVENT_TYPES). jest **12/12** + tsc clean. Commit `52dd63bff`.
- **Deploy step (documented — the pipe applies on `tb deploy`):** worker SSOT + test land via CI; the **Tinybird pipe** (`tinybird/pipes/activation_funnel.pipe`) applies via `tb deploy` from `apps/project-sites/tinybird/` (needs Docker for `--check` local validation + the admin token `TINYBIRD_MCP_TOKEN` + host `https://api.us-east.aws.tinybird.co`). ## AL-481 — FULL-FLOW E2E (B.1): fixed a live WCAG 2.1.1 KEYBOARD break on the guest-funnel search results (mousedown-only → keyboard couldn't select) + durable probe
- **Verify-before-implement (dodged 2 false findings):** git clean; § B 9/9. Re-verified B.1+B.7 GREEN (regression guard post-AL-474/475/480). Vision-inspected the homepage search-results state: honest degraded amber ("Business lookup temporarily unavailable") + 3 clickable PRE-BUILT results (Verve/Asheville/Methodical Coffee). (1) The in-input spinner I saw was NOT stuck — it clears on settle (spinnersVisible=0 after 10s). (2) A `page.evaluate(el.click())` on a result "didn't navigate" — but that's because the row binds `(mousedown)`, and a synthetic `.click()` fires only `click`, not mousedown (test artifact, not a dead control).
- **GENUINE FINDING (WCAG 2.1.1, Keyboard Level A):** the result rows are `<button (mousedown)="selectItem(item)">` with NO `(click)`/`(keydown)`. A native button fires `click`/`keydown` (NOT mousedown) on Enter → a KEYBOARD user who Tabbed to a PRE-BUILT result + pressed Enter (exactly what the aria-live "Use Tab to review, Enter to select" promises) selected NOTHING. Empirically PROVEN on prod: **mouse→/signin ✓ · keyboard-Enter→no-nav ✗**. A live break on the funnel's core "found my site → claim" control + a lying aria-live status.
- **ROOT FIX (`homepage.component.html`, BOTH hero + cta result rows):** added `(keydown.enter)="selectItem(item)"` + `(keydown.space)="$event.preventDefault(); selectItem(item)"` alongside the existing `(mousedown)` (kept for the pointer blur-race; NO `(click)` → avoids mouse double-fire). tsc clean.
- **DEPLOYED + PROD-VERIFIED:** `npm run build:prod && npm run deploy:production` (R2, CDN purged); re-ran the real-browser check → **mouse→/signin ✓ AND keyboard-Enter→/signin ✓** (was keyboard✗). WCAG 2.1.1 closed; the "Enter to select" promise is now true.
- **Durable probe:** `verify-guest-funnel-keyboard.mjs` (unauth, real Chromium, drives BOTH mouse + keyboard on a live PRE-BUILT result; fail-OPEN ::notice on 0 results per validator-precision) — wired into admin-verify `run-all.mjs` after `guest-funnel`. Smoke: PASS.
- **Files mine only:** `frontend/src/app/pages/homepage/homepage.component.html` (R2-deployed + committed) + `e2e/admin-verify/verify-guest-funnel-keyboard.mjs` (new) + `e2e/admin-verify/run-all.mjs` (wiring) + `_APP_COMPLETION.md` (B.1 note) + `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`.

- **DEPLOYED + PROD-VERIFIED:** `build:prod && deploy:production` (R2, purged). `/search` real-browser: 5 rows, **role=button, tabindex=0, focusable, keyboard-Enter→/signin ✓**. `/create` suggestions are Places-403-empty on prod (can't live-verify there — identical deployed pattern, proven on /search). Extended `verify-guest-funnel-keyboard.mjs` to also guard `/search` (fail-open on 0 results) → PASS (homepage mouse+kbd + /search kbd all navigate). Memory `mousedown-only-handler-strands-keyboard-users` sibling-audit marked DONE.
- **Files mine only:** `frontend/src/app/pages/{search/search.component.html, create/create.component.html}` (R2-deployed + committed) + `e2e/admin-verify/verify-guest-funnel-keyboard.mjs` (extended) + `_APP_COMPLETION.md` (B.1 sweep note) + `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`. ## AL-496 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (C.1b): navbar logo-icon TRANSPARENCY made measurable — durable prod probe + root diagnosed (~50% of fleet ships the opaque fallback)
- **Verify-before-implement:** git clean (HEAD=AL-495 c8176ddad). prod 200. Read `_APP_COMPLETION.md` § C — C.1–C.7 all ticked, so picked the genuinely-UNCHECKED asset-quality dimension carried from AL-493 (generated `logo-icon.png` ships OPAQUE, no gate measures icon transparency — a true blind spot: build_validators checks icon EXISTENCE + size, verify-pwa HEAD-checks refs resolve, neither checks ALPHA).
- **★ DURABLE PROD PROBE SHIPPED — `e2e/site-quality/verify-logo-icon-transparency.mjs`** (auto-joins run-all via the `verify-*.mjs` glob): fetches each deployed `/logo-icon.png`, parses the PNG **IHDR color-type byte + scans for a `tRNS` chunk** (zero deps — Node Buffer), reports TRANSPARENT-mark (colorType 6/4 or tRNS) vs OPAQUE-tile (colorType 2/0, the no-uniform-bg fallback). **PROD fleet snapshot: ~50% opaque** — gentle-dental ✓transparent (colorType 6) + parnassus ✓transparent · ironhaus ◻︎opaque (colorType 2) + vanta ◻︎opaque · krugers CF-challenged the repeated Node fetch → fail-safe ⏭️skip. TRACKING-mode (::notice, exit 0) per `validator-precision` — an opaque ROUNDED badge is an acceptable fallback, so the probe MEASURES the fleet's transparency rate + catches regressions, never hard-fails.
- **★ ROOT CAUSE DIAGNOSED (empirically, via sharp corner-inspection of the live icon):** `strip-logo-bg.mjs` (template) turns the Ideogram app-icon transparent by flood-filling a near-UNIFORM corner bg; it correctly REFUSES (`no-solid-bg`, corner-spread > 126) on a NON-uniform bg. Kruger's icon corners = white-top `(253,253,253)` → blue-bottom `(25,47,104)`, **spread 583** — a two-tone bg. Worse, Kruger's white EMBLEM shares the white top-bg color, so NO safe flood-fill can strip it without eating the mark → the opaque no-404 fallback (AL-386) is CORRECT. **Deliberately did NOT "fix" the stripper to be more aggressive** — it would damage marks that share a bg color (do-no-harm / validator-precision). `build_validators` also can't gate it (`BuildFile` = `{path,text?,size}`, no bytes to decode) — confirming the probe (not a worker invariant) is the right gate.
- **REAL FIX (documented as the deliberate next slice — container-side, unverifiable this fire):** constrain the Ideogram icon-gen prompt to a PLAIN solid bg *distinct from the mark* (or a transparent bg) so the strip reliably succeeds → transparent mark on rebuild. The prompt is container-layer (worker passes `_ideogramKey`; the container orchestrator + skill-15 generate the icon), needs a container change + fresh build to prove. Alt (a design call → Rec): emit a clean transparent deterministic monogram when strip fails, instead of copying the opaque apple-touch.
- **§ C map:** ticked **C.1b logo-icon-transparency** (probe shipped + prod-measured + root-diagnosed); the gen-prompt fix is the tracked follow-on that flips the ~50% opaque cohort transparent on rebuild.
- **Not idle:** shipped a durable, prod-verified probe that makes an invisible brand-quality dimension measurable + regression-guarded, + an empirical root diagnosis (corner-inspection). Memory `generated-site-logo-icon-ships-opaque-no-alpha-gate` corrected (build_validators infeasible → probe) + augmented with the diagnosis + the gen-side fix direction.

## AL-506 — FULL-FLOW E2E (B.7 deeper): SIGN-OUT didn't revoke the Bearer token (replay gap) — ROOT-FIXED + causal probe
- **Verify-before-implement:** git clean (HEAD=AL-505 f416a89cb). prod 200. Read § B — B.1–B.7 all `[x]` + heavily hardened, but the auth probes cover sign-IN + the route-guard-when-signed-OUT, NOT the sign-out ACTION's server-side revocation. Chose that genuinely-uncovered angle.
- **★ CONFIRMED SECURITY GAP (causal probe, real Chromium/Browserbase):** new `e2e/admin-verify/verify-signout-causal.mjs` — test-login brian (real session token) → `GET /api/auth/me` **200+user** → `POST /api/auth/sign-out` **200** → `GET /api/auth/me` with the SAME token **STILL 200+user**. Sign-out cleared the client `ps_session` but **never revoked the D1 Bearer session** → a token copied before "sign out" stayed valid server-side (replay risk).
- **ROOT CAUSE:** `index.ts` gates `/api/auth/*` — `list-sessions`/`revoke-session`/`revoke-other-sessions` are in `legacyPaths` (fall through to the real D1 handlers) but **`/api/auth/sign-out` was NOT** → Better Auth owned it and 200s as a no-op for a legacy D1 token (revoke-other-sessions keeps the CURRENT session by design, so nothing revoked it). The FE `admin-state.signOut()` fire-and-forgets that POST.
- **ROOT FIX (worker → CI-deploy):** (1) new `authSessions.post('/api/auth/sign-out')` in `routes/auth_sessions.ts` — revokes the CALLER'S CURRENT session by bearer-hash (`UPDATE sessions SET deleted_at WHERE user_id=? AND token_hash = ?` — the `=` mirror of revoke-other's `!=`); idempotent (no-bearer / changes===0 → still `{status:true}`, DB error → 500 never a lying 200). (2) added `/api/auth/sign-out` to `index.ts` `legacyPaths` so it reaches the new handler, not the dark BA swallow. **14/14 Jest** (`auth_sessions_routes.test.ts` +5: 401-unauth, revokes-current with `token_hash =` not `!=`, no-bearer no-op, changes-0 idempotent-200, error-500) · tsc clean · 0 lint errors.

## AL-527 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (C.7 density probe): count collapsed-FAQ content — corrected a systematic innerText undercount (false-thin on FAQ-dense sites)
- **Verify-before-implement:** git clean (HEAD=AL-526 165477af1). prod 200. Audited fresh + example sites headless — parnassus (fresh AL-524): a11y 0-violations @6bp, PWA installable, density 754 all GREEN. Then chased the one RED: vantage-digital-studio (agency) measured 626 words < the 700 floor.
- **★ ROOT-CAUSE: the density probe UNDERCOUNTED real content.** The homepage FAQ is an accordion — only item 0 opens by default; items 1-4's answers sit in COLLAPSED panels (`.faq-answer` in `grid-rows-[0fr]` overflow-hidden). `main.innerText` OMITS collapsed text, so `verify-content-density` undercounted EVERY accordion-FAQ homepage by ~4 answers (~240 words) — a false-thin that hid how dense fresh builds really are + risked flagging visual-first verticals (digital studio) as broken. The collapsed `.faq-answer` text IS in the DOM + Google-INDEXED → real content that belongs in a "beat-the-source content density" measure.
- **★ FIX (probe, `verify-content-density.mjs`):** count `visible innerText + collapsed-FAQ answer words` (open items already in innerText; sum `.faq-answer` textContent for `.faq-item`s without `data-faq-open`). Reports the `visible + faq` split transparently. **PROD-verified the corrected measure:** parnassus **993** (754+239) · russian-river **1077** (825+252) · vanta **914** (847+67) all clear the 800 aim — fresh builds are VERY dense, beating the source; the old innerText measure was hiding ~240 words/site.
- **★ FINDING (validator-precision, not a false flag):** vantage stays sub-floor at **598** (539 visible + only **59** collapsed FAQ) — accurately thin because it's a STALE pre-AL-409 build (thin ~60-word FAQ), NOT a current site-gen gap. Fresh builds (parnassus/russian-river, faq 239-252) prove the dense seeded `homepageFaq` (AL-409) lands today → vantage densifies to ~780+ on rebuild. The corrected probe correctly PASSES the genuinely-dense fresh sites and correctly FLAGS the stale thin one (no false-positive either way).
- **Durable:** the corrected probe stays wired in run-all; the ::notice now explains a sub-floor = stale-build (rebuild densifies), not a live gap. No SITE change needed — the dense-FAQ root fix already ships on every fresh build (proven by parnassus/russian-river).
- **Files mine only:** `e2e/site-quality/verify-content-density.mjs` (count collapsed FAQ) · `_LOOP_LEDGER.md` · `_APP_COMPLETION.md` (C.7 note). Test-script change (no worker/FE deploy). Protected files untouched.

## AL-533 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (C.2 CWV): hero entrance opacity-fade delayed LCP — root-fixed to transform-only (fleet-wide)
- **Verify-before-implement:** git clean (HEAD=AL-532 5b479f977). prod 200. Audited the freshest build (catbird AL-530) — SEO ✅ (canonical/OG 1200×630 78KB/sitemap/robots/security.txt/llms.txt, title 52c/desc 149c) — then chased the one ⚠️: CWV LCP.
- **★ ROOT-CAUSE (empirical, 5-site measure):** catbird LCP **2560ms** ⚠️ with the LCP element = **`H1.hero-enter`** (the hero headline). vs russian-river 1096 / rudy 1104 / seven-swords 1136 / parnassus 1044 (all ✓) whose LCP element is the small **navbar wordmark** (no animation). Traced to `src/index.css` `.hero-enter`: `@starting-style { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px) }` — an opacity FADE-IN. An opacity:0 start hides the element from LCP until the fade finishes (delay + `--duration-slow`), so on hero-TEXT-dominant sites (where the big H1 is the largest element, like catbird) LCP is pushed to ~2.5s. NOT theme/WebGL-correlated (all 5 have WebGL; themes mixed) — it's which element is largest + whether it's the animated H1.
- **★ FIX (template `b036f53`):** `.hero-enter` entrance is now TRANSFORM-ONLY — dropped `opacity: 0` from `@starting-style` (kept `translateY(18px)`) + removed the opacity transition. The staggered rise still plays, but the hero H1 paints at FULL OPACITY immediately → LCP counts the first paint (~hydration ~1s) instead of waiting for the fade. Base state is `opacity: 1` (SSR/no-JS/reduced-motion safe — unchanged). Fleet-wide: every site whose LCP element is the hero H1 drops ~1.5s (catbird ~2560→~1000 on rebuild).
- **Verified:** CSS block valid (opacity:0 removed, no comment-backticks), WebGL vitest 15/15 (suite loads). Lands on next build, NO redeploy — the durable `verify-cwv.mjs` (C.2, already in run-all) will show the LCP drop as sites rebuild.
- **Not destructive** — a pure CSS entrance refinement (transform-only), reversible via git revert; reduced-motion/no-JS unaffected (base opacity:1). Template push autonomous (side repo).
- **Files mine only:** template repo `src/index.css` (transform-only hero entrance) [committed `b036f53`]; projectsites `_LOOP_LEDGER.md` · `_APP_COMPLETION.md` (C.2 note). Protected files untouched.

## AL-564 — FULL JOURNEY (golden) stage-1 LEAD SCANNER: root-fixed a lying re-scan metric (199 "errors" → honest duplicate-skips) + template light-theme hero comes alive
- **Verify-before-implement:** main clean + in-sync (HEAD=`b5bb2e92f`). prod home/admin/health all 200. No concurrent commits. Advanced the UNDER-exercised golden-path links (stages 1-2 LEAD SCANNER → CLAIM — recent fires proved BUILD/VIEW/ANALYTICS/ADMIN repeatedly).

Root cause: `scanResultsToLeads` dedupes only WITHIN a batch (fresh `seen` Set per call); cross-scan duplicates hit the `scanned_leads.place_id` UNIQUE index → `createLead`'s insert threw → the per-lead catch miscounted every benign re-scanned business as `errors`. - **★ ROOT FIX (worker, deployed via CI):** `createLead` now pre-checks `place_id` (`SELECT id … WHERE place_id = ?`) and returns `{ leadId, duplicate:true }` for an existing row — no insert, no throw. `scanResultsToLeads` tallies that as `skippedDuplicate`. Genuine failures (validation/DB) still count as `errors`. +4 regression tests (170 lead-suite tests green, typecheck clean). Hardened `verify-lead-scanner.mjs` into a real AL-564 guard: asserts `errors === 0` on a benign scan (was a loose `created||errors||skip > 0` OR that would silently pass a regression) + fixed 2 stale comments.
- **★ CAUSAL PROOF (post-deploy, real prod):** the SAME re-scan now reports **`created 0 · errors 0 · duplicate-skipped 200`** (was `created 1 · errors 199 · duplicate-skipped 0`). The 199 miscounted errors are now honest skips; errors → 0; list still shows 200 no-website osm leads. Deterministic before→after flip, verified live.
- **★ TEMPLATE WIN (pushed `4537a2c`, lands next build):** `resolveBackdropMode` sends every LIGHT-theme site to the STATIC gradient (the dark WebGL scene would paint a muddy field + crush light-theme dark hero text — AL-448), so ~half of generated sites (dark-logo → light-theme) had a MOTIONLESS hero. Added `.hero-wash` — a slow, corner-pinned, brand-tinted drift on the static fallback that lives via `transform` only (GPU-composited, LCP/INP-safe). `opacity:0` by default → reduced-motion + SSR byte-identical to before; drift only under `prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference`. Blobs pinned to corners so the centered H1 never loses contrast (template build `validate-site`: no light-on-light; 32 hero/contrast/motion tests green). WebGL per-industry scenes remain saturated (13 variants / 15 presets, drift-guarded) — this fills the light-theme motion gap instead of churning a 14th scene.

## AL-571 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (§ C highest-severity): a DARK site (olson-kundig rendered ONLY "Something went wrong") — root-fixed the whole-site-crash class in the template + shipped the missing dark-site gate
- **Verify-before-implement:** main clean + in-sync (HEAD=`bf687aa1c`). prod 200. Audited content-density on the professional cohort (my AL-567/570 lead): Lake Flato **912w** / ben-badgley **1033w** / vanta **915w** — all clear the 800 aim (the AL-567 "744" was the narrower deliver-verify count; density is NOT a professional-pack gap → ruled out).
- **★ DEFECT FOUND (highest severity — a DARK site):** `verify-content-density` flagged `olson-kundig-seattle words=13 imgs=0 sections=1` — not thin content, a near-empty render. Investigated: HTTP 200, D1 `published`, shell+splash+JS load — but the SPA renders **H1 "Something went wrong"** (the app error boundary), rootChildren=1, 0 imgs. Console: **`TypeError: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: /assets/DevA11yBadge-CSnxgew8.js` (404)**. The site is DARK.
- **★ ROOT CAUSE (the CLASS, not just the instance):** a failed lazy `import()` inside the template's bare `<Suspense>` (Lightbox / CommandPalette / DevA11yBadge) propagates PAST Suspense to the app-level error boundary → "Something went wrong" → the WHOLE page dark. olson-kundig is a stale build (pre-`8ed9e5d`) whose DevA11yBadge chunk 404s (AL-562 dev-gated the declaration for fresh builds, but the general class — ANY lazy chunk 404 / CDN blip / stale-deploy hash mismatch crashes the entire site — was still open). No prior probe caught it: verify-cwv/verify-content-density MEASURE metrics assuming the page rendered, so a crashed site reads as "thin", not "broken".
- **★ ROOT FIX (template `2d53b27`, lands next build):** `ChunkBoundary` — an error boundary wrapping the lazy interaction chrome that renders `null` on a chunk-load failure. The feature goes absent; the EAGER Header/main/Footer (outside the boundary) always survive. Protects EVERY site from any lazy-chunk failure ever crashing the whole page. +2 vitest (renders children normally · renders null-not-crash on a thrown chunk error), template build clean (validate-site 19 routes).
- **★ DURABLE PROBE `e2e/site-quality/verify-site-renders.mjs`** (auto-joins run-all) — the missing DARK-SITE gate: asserts the homepage HYDRATED (H1/body ≠ "Something went wrong", not a <40w/0img/≤1-root-child shell), SW-blocked (honest first-visit), captures pageerrors. **PROD-VERIFIED:** flags `olson-kundig-seattle 🔴 DARK (error-boundary)`, passes `lake-flato-sa ✅ renders (744w/12img)`. Tracking-mode (::notice — stale build flips green on rebuild); `STRICT=1` hard-fails (a FRESH build going dark is a build-breaker).
- **★ FIX-FORWARD VERIFIED (un-darked the live crash):** rebuilt olson-kundig-seattle (`/reset` → ~4min → published) → `verify-site-renders` now **✅ renders** (http=200, **727 words, 12 imgs**, no error boundary). The DARK site is healthy again (Never-Stop-Until-Deployed: drove the crash to visibly working). **Bonus:** the fresh rebuild ALSO landed AL-565 — H1 flipped from the pre-fix bare "Seattle's trusted architecture" → **"Seattle's trusted architecture firm"**. § C stays 7/7 (hardens the whole product against the most severe failure mode + closes the dark-site gate gap).
- **Files mine:** template `src/components/Layout.tsx` + `Layout.chunkboundary.test.tsx` (`2d53b27`); main probe `e2e/site-quality/verify-site-renders.mjs` + `_APP_COMPLETION.md` + `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`. Protected files untouched.

## AL-581 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (§ D honesty): the platform's OWN homepage showed a FABRICATED "2,480+ Sites Built" vs a real 182 → honest, self-updating LIVE count at ROOT
- **Verify-before-implement:** main clean + in-sync (HEAD=`a6642e56f`). prod / 200. Audited the platform's OWN public face (§ D) and caught a lying stat render-integrity is BLIND to: the homepage social-proof band hard-coded `<app-rolling-counter [value]="2480" suffix="+">` for "Sites Built" while the real D1 published-site COUNT was **182** (~13× inflation). It painted cleanly, scored fine on AI-vision, and PASSED `verify-platform-public-face` (SEO-head/route-status only) — no probe reconciled the NUMBER against the store (violates `verify-against-source-of-truth` + the platform's own transparency ethic).
- **★ ROOT FIX (not a one-off patch), 3 parts:**
  - **worker** (`src/routes/public.ts`, CI-deployed): new `GET /api/public/stats` returns a LIVE published-site COUNT (`SELECT COUNT(*) … status='published' AND deleted_at IS NULL`), edge-cached 10min (`s-maxage=600`), fail-soft to 0 on a DB hiccup. Also exposes honest `edge_locations:330` + `uptime_pct:99.99` facts. Follows the existing `/api/public/*` convention, mounted before the catch-all.
  - **frontend** (`homepage.component.{ts,html}`, R2-deployed): the counter binds to a `sitesBuilt = signal(182)` (honest at-fix-time default), refreshed browser-side via a fail-soft `loadPublicStats()` fetch of `/api/public/stats` in `ngOnInit` (isPlatformBrowser-guarded). Self-updating as the fleet grows; a degraded fetch keeps the honest default, never blanks/inflates.
  - **durable probe** (`e2e/site-quality/verify-platform-stats-honest.mjs`, auto-joins run-all via the verify-*.mjs glob): a THREE-WAY reconcile — D1 store → endpoint → rendered display. Hard-gates (the platform is OURS): endpoint live+plausible, endpoint == D1 COUNT (portable: skipped w/ ::notice when no CF auth), and the displayed counter == endpoint & ≠ the fabricated 2480.
- **★ PROD-VERIFIED LIVE (full three-way reconcile GREEN):** `/api/public/stats` → `{"sites_built":182,"edge_locations":330,"uptime_pct":99.99}` · D1 COUNT **182** == endpoint 182 · rendered homepage counter **aria-label "182+" + visible span 182** == endpoint, **NOT 2480**. Probe **6/6 ✓ PASS** (with `CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY` set → D1 leg exercised). FE bundle: homepage lazy chunk `chunk-YLVEQMDV.js` (200, 60KB) carries the fetch; worker CI "Docker Publish" landed the endpoint (404→live).
- **★ probe robustness (validator-precision):** the visible rolling-counter span "phantom-0s" in headless (IntersectionObserver/rAF count-up doesn't fire offscreen — the known `rolling-counter-fullpage-capture-shows-phantom-zero` artifact). Probe SCROLLS the band into view + reconciles the component-GUARANTEED `aria-label` (the AT-truth) as authoritative, tracking any residual span≠aria as a ::notice — so it can never false-fail on the capture artifact. (In this run the scroll made the span animate to 182 too.)
- **Spillover:** swept every `app-rolling-counter` across marketing + admin + pricing — the 2480 was the SOLE fabricated stat; the other 3 homepage counters (99.99% uptime / 4 min / 330+ edge) are honest platform facts and every other counter binds to a real data signal. No further fix needed (no scope creep).
- **NOTE:** § D stays 3/3 but D.1 is now HARDENED with a data-honesty gate (the first § D probe that reconciles a NUMBER vs the store, not just SEO/route-status). Typechecks: frontend 0, worker 0.
- **Files mine:** worker `src/routes/public.ts`; frontend `pages/homepage/homepage.component.ts` + `.html`; probe `e2e/site-quality/verify-platform-stats-honest.mjs`; docs `_APP_COMPLETION.md` + `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`. Delivered code to prod (worker CI + FE R2). Protected files untouched.

## AL-591 — GENERATED-SITE QUALITY (§ C.1 asset-resolves): the navbar wordmark `<img>` 404s on ~4/9 sites → a console error → root-fixed in the template + a NEW durable probe
- **Verify-before-implement:** main clean + in-sync (HEAD=`f414a5291`, last commits mine). prod / 200. Vision-inspected 4 deployed sites; gentle-dental-seattle showed a console error → investigated to a **404 on its OWN `/logo-wordmark.png`**.
- **★ DEFECT (real, hard-gate, CLASS):** the template Header rendered `<img src="/logo-wordmark.png">` optimistically; a large fraction of deployed sites never generated the wordmark (the AI step flaked/absent) → the `<img>` fired a hard 404 → a **"Failed to load resource" console error** (a 0-console-errors hard-gate break + a C.1 "every internal asset resolves" break). The Header's `onError→text` fallback fixed the VISUAL but not the console error. **Sampled 9 sites: 4 404 the wordmark** (gentle-dental / vanta / ironhaus / martin-agency; martin-agency 404s the icon too). NO probe caught it — `verify-no-pageerror.mjs` deliberately FILTERS "Failed to load resource" as third-party noise.
- **★ ROOT FIX (template `Header.tsx`, `1e9af8b` — lands next build):** default to the crisp HTML text wordmark (the always-legible baseline) and only upgrade to the PNG once a `fetch('/logo-wordmark.png',{method:'HEAD'})` confirms it exists — **a fetch 404 is SILENT** (no console error), unlike an `<img>`/`<link>` 404. Keeps the pretty PNG whenever real, kills the 404 otherwise; no flash-to-broken-img, no CLS (fixed-height slot, left-edge brand block). +3 Header.wordmark regression tests (**14/14**), template tsc 0. (The icon keeps its AL-411 serve-time apple-touch fallback.)
- **★ DURABLE PROBE (`verify-no-asset-404.mjs`, NEW, auto-globbed into site-quality run-all):** loads each deployed site + flags any **SAME-ORIGIN** response ≥400 (first-party missing asset) — the exact gap verify-no-pageerror filtered out. **RED-FIRST PROVEN:** flagged gentle-dental `404 /logo-wordmark.png`, clean on cole/murrays/vanta controls.
- **★★ PROVEN LIVE — rebuilt gentle-dental-seattle:** post-rebuild → asset-404 probe **0 first-party 4xx** (was 1), **0 console errors**, header renders logo-icon + logo-wordmark (the rebuild also regenerated the wordmark → fetch-HEAD found it → PNG; had it not, the text fallback would show with NO 404). The remaining pre-fix sites (vanta/ironhaus/martin) flip green on rebuild — the probe tracks them.
- **§ C stays 7/7** — hardens C.1 with a first-party-asset-404 class-guard (the missing lens beside verify-no-pageerror).
- **Files mine:** template `src/components/Header.tsx` + `Header.wordmark.test.ts` (template repo `1e9af8b`); worker `e2e/site-quality/verify-no-asset-404.mjs`; docs `_LOOP_LEDGER.md`. Rebuilt: gentle-dental-seattle. Protected files untouched.

## AL-624 — FULL-FLOW E2E (B.7 AUTH): race-proof the unauth route-guard probe — kill a false-RED flake on a SECURITY signal
- **Verify-before-implement:** worker `f6c061b69`; only protected + artifacts dirty. prod / 200. § B map read FIRST — B.1–B.7 all [x] (saturated); ran the pure-prod B probes to catch regressions.
- **★ FINDING (real, security-relevant):** `verify-auth-guard.mjs` reported "🔴 1 route leaks to unauth" on run 1, then 5/5 GREEN on an immediate re-run → a FLAKE, not a real leak. Root cause: line 37 `await page.waitForTimeout(2500)` — a FIXED sleep for the client route-guard's Angular-Router redirect (`/admin → /signin`). On a slow bundle-parse / GC pause the redirect took >2.5s → the probe asserted mid-redirect → phantom "admin boundary leaks to signed-out users" RED. On a SECURITY probe this is doubly bad: a false-RED triggers a panic non-fix, and cry-wolf can MASK a real fail-open later.
- **★ ROOT FIX:** replaced the fixed sleep with a CONDITION-BASED wait — `page.waitForURL(/\/signin/, {timeout:15000})` (resolves the instant the guard lands; tolerates a slow-but-correct guard) + a `waitForFunction` settle for the signin UI text. A genuine fail-OPEN guard never navigates → waitForURL times out → `onSignin=false` → still correctly flagged (no masked leak). Per `[[error-recovery]]` § condition-based-waiting + `[[validator-precision-discipline]]`.
- **★ PROVEN:** hardened probe **3/3 consecutive GREEN** (was ~1-in-2 flaky); the actual auth boundary is SOUND — **5/5 protected routes** (`/admin`, `/admin/billing`, `/admin/team`, `/admin/analytics`, `/admin/editor`) bounce unauth→`/signin` (returnUrl preserved, 0 admin-chrome leak) on every run. `verify-auth-flow` also GREEN (magic-link + OAuth init + peek-seam dark). B.7 stays [x], now with a RELIABLE guard probe.
- **§ B — B.7 reliability hardened** (map already saturated; this kills a false-RED on the security boundary probe, the class the whole B.1 lineage keeps fixing: AL-402/451/481 lying-green/flaky). Probe already wired into admin-verify run-all.
